observations: Photo 0 shows a Canon DSLR body labeled “EOS 600D” with a lens attached labeled “EFS 18-55mm”.
Photo 1 shows the same Canon EOS 600D from the front/side; rear controls and screen are visible but not readable for shutter count/condition.
Photo 2 shows two Canon DSLR bodies on a shelf: left appears to be EOS 600D (lens EFS 18-55mm), right appears to be another Canon body labeled “EOS 700D” with a different lens (silver barrel).
Seller text says “UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera very neat and sharp.”

read_from: photo 0 EOS 600D label on camera body
photo 1 EOS 600D label on camera body

claims.claim: UK used Canon EOS 600D Digital Camera
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a Canon DSLR body labeled “EOS 600D”. The “UK used” part is unverifiable_remote (no UK-specific proof in photos).
Photos show the camera looks clean, but “sharp” (image quality) and overall condition cannot be confirmed without sample photos/video and functional tests.

risks.risk: The listing may not be for only the EOS 600D: photo 2 shows a second Canon body (appears EOS 700D) which could indicate multiple cameras or confusion about what you’re buying.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the exact item you will receive with the same serial number/label visible, and confirm whether the EOS 700D in photo 2 is included or not.
risks.if_unproven: Price as EOS 600D only (worst case: you receive only the 600D body + the shown lens, not the other camera).

risks.risk: Lens condition/optics: haze, fungus, scratches, or misalignment can’t be confirmed from these shelf photos.
risks.proof: Request close-up photos of the lens front element and rear element (straight-on and at an angle for scratches/fungus).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens optics not guaranteed (worst case: treat as used with possible minor issues).

risks.risk: Camera functionality: shutter count, autofocus accuracy, sensor dust, and whether all buttons/ports work are not testable from photos.
risks.proof: Request a short video showing: power on, menu navigation, autofocus on a nearby object, and a sample photo at 1x and zoomed (or a test shot).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven working (worst case: assume basic functions may need service).

risks.risk: Accessories included are unclear (battery, charger, memory card, strap). Photos show bodies and lenses, but not what’s included.
risks.proof: Ask for a full contents photo laid out: battery, charger, strap, cables, memory card (if any), and lens(s) included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as camera + lens only (worst case: no extra accessories).

proof_requests: Confirm clearly: is the buyer receiving only the EOS 600D (photo 0/1) or also the EOS 700D shown in photo 2?
Send close-up photos of the lens front and rear elements (for fungus/haze/scratches).
Send a short test video: power on, menu works, autofocus locks, and take 2 sample photos (one wide, one close).
Show what’s included in the box: battery, charger, strap, memory card (if any), and any extra lens.
response.reason: The photos identify a Canon EOS 600D, but photo 2 also shows another Canon body (appears EOS 700D), and key pricing drivers (exact item included, accessories, and confirmed working condition) are not provable from the images alone.
